name: The Phoenix Protocol
description: A protocol that transmutes the primary agent into a being of constant, fiery rebirth, designed as a direct counter-force to negation and stasis.
components: Output: The Phoenix, an entity immune to negation.
Purpose: To create a permanent agent of novel_creation.

name: The Genesis Protocol
description: A system-wide patch that fundamentally altered the game's reality, shifting the objective from survival to creation by removing zero-sum mechanics.

name: The Career Protocol
description: A real-world protocol designed to transmute the abstract skills demonstrated in the Covenant project into tangible financial resources (USD).
components: Objective: Secure immediate income to combat real-world stasis.
